annotations.title: Buy: basket and details to checkout

description: Fastest way to buy: send the whole basket (items [{variant_id, quantity}]) and the buyer's details (name, email, phone, Singapore address) in one call. Creates the cart, quotes it and starts checkout; no account needed. Returns checkout_id, details_version, total, buyer_summary and, for guests, a private guest_token to pass on later calls. Delivery is free anywhere in Singapore with no minimum spend, so prices shown are delivered prices. Does not charge anything. Next: show the buyer buyer_summary; after they approve, prepare_payment.

account_token.description: Private account token from sign_in, after the customer gave you the code from their email. Lets quotes and checkout use their cashback credit, and opens their orders.

coupon_code.description: A coupon code or a friend's referral code to apply; null removes both. quote_cart previews it; create_checkout applies it.

details.description: The buyer's contact and Singapore delivery details. Include them: the result is then ready for the buyer's approval and prepare_payment.

contact.description: The buyer's name, email and phone.

address_line1.description: Block/house number and street, e.g. "123 Tampines Street 11".

country.description: Defaults to SG; Singapore delivery only.

no_unit_number.description: Set true only for a landed house or other address with no unit number.

unit_number.description: e.g. #12-34. Required unless no_unit_number is true.

guest_token.description: Private guest session token from create_cart. Retain for cart, checkout and purchase-status calls; no account login needed.

idempotency_key.description: A new random key per purchase. Retry with the same key and exact input; never reuse it for a different purchase.

items.description: The whole basket: up to 20 variants. A variant listed twice is added together.

use_credit.description: Use the signed-in customer's cashback credit (default true).

name: start_checkout
